annotations.title: Create a new agent from a process I describe

description: Draft a new Dactic agent, and the new skills it needs, from a process the user describes in this chat — use this when the user's existing skills don't cover the work (synthesize_agent only reuses existing skills). The input includes purpose, concrete ordered steps, trigger, resources, and constraints for the process. Runs in the background: returns a task_id; call get_task_status until succeeded (with the draft and its review link) or failed. The draft is saved for review in the Dactic app and is never deployed from here. target_platform claude only; Monday agents are created in the Dactic app.

constraints.description: Things the agent must never do.

resources.description: Data sources or tools the agent uses.
